messages:
maria_support: Heads up — Acme reported a big p99 regression starting ~16:10 UTC, app-level latency spikes and some 401s causing retries. Customer says it started right after a billing plan change this morning.

jason_oncall: copying logs from the tenant: looks like a burst of auth failures then lots of long tails. throwing this in the incident channel too.

maria_support: here's the snippet customer pasted (sanitized):
```
2026-03-16T16:09:57Z ERROR auth: token validation failed status=401 tenant=acme-research
2026-03-16T16:10:02Z WARN request: retrying due to upstream 401 attempt=3 req_id=abc-123
2026-03-16T16:10:04Z INFO runtime: started invoke model=redwood-xl seq_len=1024 tenant=acme-research
2026-03-16T16:10:04Z INFO runtime: kv_cache_hit=false kv_size=0 alloc_mb=6432 p99=2.1s
2026-03-16T16:10:06Z ERROR gpu: OOM while allocating 128MB for KV shard tenant=acme-research pid=2345
```

sam_runtime: OOM in the middle of concurrent requests + auth retries — that combo can inflate KV growth. If auth fails, client retries with new session, we may not evict old prefixes quickly and KV per-tenant can grow.

alex_ml: do we have memtrend for that node? any slab fragmentation?

li_infra: pulling node memory metrics now. nvidia-smi and our allocator logs from the host show persistent fragmentation and a growing number of small allocations in the KV arena. snippet: 
```
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.total,memory.used --format=csv
"GPU 0, 32768 MiB, 27940 MiB used"
allocator: arena=kv_shard_12 free=3.2MB fragments=412 largest_free=1.2MB
```

maria_support: customer says they hit ~p99 5.3s for generation requests and some 500s. They also saw occasional 429s from our API after the auth flurry.

jason_oncall: quick repro steps I ran locally: 1) repeatedly call generate with an expired token 2) client reauths and retries, 3) parallel warm requests with seq_len=2048. After ~1500 requests KV size climbed by ~1.2GB on that worker.

sam_runtime: temp mitigations we should consider now: 1) throttle per-tenant concurrent inflight requests (apply token-based concurrency cap) 2) force a targeted worker recycle for the tenant's placement (fast restart) 3) enable aggressive KV eviction for that tenant for 10m.

li_infra: I can do a hot-restart for the affected worker node in the region and flip a config to drop per-tenant KV after restart. Doing that now. (will coordinate with deploy-bot)

deploy-bot: scheduled restart for worker-57 in us-west-2 in 60s. will drain connections for 30s then restart.

alex_ml: longer-term: we should (A) tighten KV LRU for auth-failed sessions (drop on repeated 401s), (B) add per-tenant KV caps + telemetry, and (C) improve allocator coalescing to reduce fragmentation. Also consider compact-on-low-memory heuristic.

jason_oncall: +1 on telemetry — need a metric for "kv_entries_per_tenant" and slab_frag_pct to alert before p95 crosses threshold.

maria_support: billing angle — customer upgraded plan at 16:08 and got a webhook; billingbot shows two rapid checkout events. Could that have triggered a token refresh loop?

billingbot: webhook delivered for tenant acme-research plan=enterprise at 2026-03-16T16:08:45Z. No errors on our side. Customer's identity provider returned 500 for a few auth attempts per their logs.

sam_runtime: that matches — their IdP 500s -> our clients retried -> higher concurrency and duplicate sessions -> KV growth. Root cause chain looks like: IdP instability -> client retries -> runtime KV growth + fragmentation -> OOMs -> p99 spikes.

li_infra: restart complete. worker-57 back up. I applied temporary config: kv.eviction_policy=aggressive for tenant acme-research; concurrency cap=8. Monitoring now.

maria_support: customer confirmed latency dropped back to acceptable levels after you restarted. They still want postmortem and a mitigation plan.

jason_oncall: next steps assigned:
- sam_runtime: implement temporary alert for kv_entries_per_tenant > 800k and slab_frag_pct > 60% (ETA 48h)
- alex_ml: propose allocator compaction patch and a compact-on-threshold strategy (ETA PR in 2 weeks)
- li_infra: add operator script to trigger targeted per-tenant eviction and safe restarts (ETA tomorrow)
- maria_support: draft customer-facing note explaining rollback and mitigations (ETA 2h)

alex_ml: also adding a small service tweak: mark KV entries created during auth failures with a short TTL (30s) so retry storms don't seed long-lived entries. I'll prototype.

maria_support: thx all. I'll loop in the account team and send the customer a status update now. :thumbsup:

jason_oncall: logging this as SEV3 for tracking. will link to this thread in the ticket.

sam_runtime: leaving a quick runbook entry: when tenant p99 jumps and OOMs show up, check auth event spikes, look for client retry storms, consider eviction + worker restart before scaling.

maria_support: closing the immediate escalation since perf stabilized, keeping this open until follow-ups done.
